_doc: Survivor behaviour per skill key (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 7, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Canonical per-level numbers (fixdamage, mad, mastery, attackCount, x, pdd) are NOT here: SkillBook reads them from Skill.wz via setup.skill_imgs[book].skill[<7-digit id>].level[<level>]. ranks[r-1] = canonical skill level at survivor rank r. cooldown (s), range (px), speed (px/s), count (projectiles or targets), pierce (extra mobs a shot passes through), radius (shot hit radius, px), action_time (s of the cast stance) are tier C (ours). damage: fixed = canonical fixdamage; magic = GAME_DESIGN 6.1 formula with canonical mad/mastery; none = passive. Visual and sound fields are WZ paths into the asset cache; {level} = canonical level, {cl} = the char_level variant (the highest threshold <= character level). buff.stat/field/duration_field: active effect and canonical duration; Magic Guard x% feeds mp_guard, Magic Armor pdd feeds defense, canonical time gives seconds. level_ranks {character level: rank}: the skill reaches at least that survivor rank at that character level (the SP a v83 Beginner spends on Three Snails; cards can get there sooner).

recovery.name: Recovery
recovery.desc: Heals HP every 5 seconds for 30 seconds when hurt.
recovery._buff: Tier C: cast below 50% HP; interpret canonical x as HP every 5 s, six pulses including the final pulse at 30 s. Values, duration, MP cost and cooldown stay canonical.

three_snails.desc: Hurls snail shells at the nearest monster.
